def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}

add='''

def find_multicolor_bar(grid):
    """The first (row, col0, col1, colors) of a 3-row vertical bar whose middle row segment has 3+ distinct nonzero colors."""
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for i in range(1,H-1):
        for j in range(W):
            if grid[i][j]:
                a=j
                while a>0 and grid[i][a-1]: a-=1
                b=j
                while b+1<W and grid[i][b+1]: b+=1
                seg=[grid[i][x] for x in range(a,b+1)]
                if len(set(seg))>=3 and all(grid[i-1][x]!=0 and grid[i-1][x]==grid[i][x] and grid[i+1][x]==grid[i][x] for x in range(a,b+1)):
                    return i-1,a,b,seg
    return None

def shape_bbox(grid, color, exclude=None):
    """(top,bottom,left,right) of all cells of color, excluding an optional (row0,row1,col0,col1) box."""
    ex=exclude or (-1,-1,-1,-1)
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0]))
           if grid[r][c]==color and not (ex[0]<=r<=ex[1] and ex[2]<=c<=ex[3])]
    return min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells),min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)

def tile_shape_by_colors(grid):
    """Recolor and vertically tile the single-color shape once per color of the multicolor bar, keeping the shape color's copy in place."""
    hit=find_multicolor_bar(grid)
    if not hit: return grid
    srow,c0,c1,colors=hit
    ex=(srow,srow+2,c0,c1)
    cshape=next(c for c in colors if any(grid[r][x]==c and not (ex[0]<=r<=ex[1] and ex[2]<=x<=ex[3]) for r in range(len(grid)) for x in range(len(grid[0]))))
    r0,r1,cc0,cc1=shape_bbox(grid,cshape,ex)
    h=r1-r0+1
    sub=[[grid[r][x] for x in range(cc0,cc1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    idx=colors.index(cshape)
    out=[[0]*len(grid[0]) for _ in range(len(grid))]
    for k,col in enumerate(colors):
        off=(k-idx)*h
        for r,row in enumerate(sub):
            for x,v in enumerate(row):
                if v: out[r0+off+r][cc0+x]=col
    return out
'''
